name: CloseAppsRowDetail
where: tab "Away and back": the explanation under Close apps, on both sides; replaces approved line 77, whose "any unsaved work is lost" the warning under it now says more exactly

name: CloseAppsWarning
en: SteppedOut can't save your work. Each app is asked to close first, as if you clicked its X, and it's up to the app whether unsaved work is kept. Apps still open after 30 seconds are closed anyway.
ar: قد تفقد التغييرات غير المحفوظة. يطلب SteppedOut من كل تطبيق أن يُغلق كما لو نقرت على زر الإغلاق، ثم يفرض إغلاق ما يبقى مفتوحًا بعد 30 ثانية.
where: tab "Away and back": the warning above the apps in Close apps, on both sides, with an icon in the warning color; screen readers hear it on the list of apps
